intro: Four steps, about 15 minutes. Deadline: 23:00. Step 4 is a voice note. Vocab Quest: open Foundation Vocab Quest on the website and finish today's 18 words (Week 6).

steps.title: Step 1 · Write the word
steps.instructions: Read the clue and write the Lesson 8 word. The first letter is given.

items.label: 2. You pay this money to study. (t)
3. The school gives you money because you study well. (s)
4. A student in the first year. (f)
5. Students meet to study together. (s g)
6. You eat lunch here at university. (c)

steps.title: Step 2 · Is, Are, Do or Does?

items.label: 1. ____ there a cafeteria on your campus?

3. ____ your friends in a study group?

steps.title: Step 4 · Speaking Part 1
steps.instructions: Answer the 3 questions. Give 2 or 3 sentences for each answer, with a reason (because ...). Use at least 2 Lesson 8 words. Record one voice note.
lines: 3. Do you like your school or university? Why?
steps.note: No fixed answer. Teacher listens for 2 to 3 sentences, because, Lesson 8 words, correct he/she -s.
